newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Investors face phone nightmare at Tanzania forum.
newsitem.headline: Investors face phone nightmare at Tanzania forum.

text.p: Investors at an international forum in Tanzania have collided head-on with one of the country's key problems -- telephones.

Making deals by telephone has not been easy. Investors have found out that getting a connection to the Sheraton Hotel -- venue for the November 5-8 investor gathering -- whether calling from outside or inside Tanzania, is difficult.

The five-star Sheraton Hotel was so stung that on Thursday it placed a huge advert in an English-language newspaper, apologising to its clients for the phone chaos and laying blame at the feet of the state phone company.
"We are trying to find a solution to this fault with the Tanzania Telecommunications Co Ltd who have been contacted repeatedly but have not been able to assist to date," it said.

Tanzanian officials see the forum as a key springboard for building investor confidence in Tanzania, one of the world's poorest countries, now trying to shake off the legacy of almost 30 years of debilitating socialist-inspired economic policies.
One investor said the pathetic telephone connections were a critical reminder that more steps needed to be taken to improve infrastructure to attract foreign investors.
